topics.title: Validity of marriage
topics.detail: Void and voidable marriages under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and the Special Marriage Act, 1954; nullity (prohibited relationship, underage marriage, non-consummation); bigamy; fraud, misrepresentation or concealment of material facts such as health or an earlier marriage.

topics.title: Divorce & separation
topics.detail: Divorce by mutual consent or contested divorce on grounds such as cruelty, desertion, adultery, conversion or mental disorder; judicial separation; restitution of conjugal rights.

topics.title: Maintenance & alimony
topics.detail: Maintenance for wife, children and parents under Section 144 BNSS (earlier Section 125 CrPC) and personal laws; interim maintenance during proceedings; permanent alimony and final settlement.

topics.title: Children
topics.detail: Custody, guardianship, visitation rights, child support and education expenses.

topics.title: Matrimonial property
topics.detail: Recovery of streedhan and dowry articles; rights in the matrimonial home; division of jointly acquired property, house, land and jewellery.

topics.title: Domestic violence
topics.detail: Physical, emotional, verbal and economic abuse and mental harassment; protection, residence, custody and monetary relief orders under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005.

topics.title: Dowry
topics.detail: Dowry demands before or after marriage; complaints under the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961; recovery of dowry articles.

topics.title: Criminal cases arising out of marriage
topics.detail: Cruelty by husband or his relatives (Sections 85–86 BNS, earlier 498A IPC); criminal breach of trust over streedhan (Section 316 BNS, earlier 406 IPC); bigamy (Section 82 BNS, earlier 494 IPC); dowry death (Section 80 BNS, earlier 304B IPC); abetment of suicide (Section 108 BNS, earlier 306 IPC).

topics.title: Inter-caste and inter-faith couples
topics.detail: Protection from family pressure, threats and honour-based harassment.

topics.title: Other family matters
topics.detail: Desertion and abandonment, adoption, inheritance and succession rights after divorce or separation, and disputes involving NRI spouses.

topics.title: Court marriage
topics.detail: Marriage under the Special Marriage Act, 1954: notice of intended marriage, objection period and solemnisation before the Marriage Officer.

topics.title: Registration of marriage
topics.detail: Registration of marriages already solemnised and obtaining a marriage certificate under the applicable Haryana rules.

topics.title: Live-in relationships
topics.detail: Awareness of the rights and protections available to couples in live-in relationships, and help with declarations and related documents.

topics.title: Complaints & FIRs
topics.detail: Drafting police complaints; Zero FIR; what to do if the police refuse to register an FIR (complaint to the Superintendent of Police, application to the Magistrate under Section 175(3) BNSS, earlier 156(3) CrPC); private complaints before the Magistrate.

topics.title: Advice to complainants and accused persons
topics.detail: Rights on arrest, the offences involved and the remedies available.

topics.title: Bail
topics.detail: Anticipatory bail (Section 482 BNSS, earlier 438 CrPC), regular bail, interim protection from arrest and challenges to remand or custody orders.

topics.title: Investigation stage
topics.detail: Guidance on recording of statements and on search and seizure; applications for fair or court-monitored investigation.

topics.title: Trial stage
topics.detail: Framing of charges and discharge applications, evidence and cross-examination, and final arguments.

topics.title: After the trial
topics.detail: Appeals against conviction or acquittal, criminal revisions, suspension of sentence pending appeal, and parole and furlough.

topics.title: Victim relief
topics.detail: Victim compensation (Section 396 BNSS, earlier 357A CrPC) and the rights of victims during investigation and trial.

topics.title: Economic offences
topics.detail: Cheque bounce (Section 138, Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881), cheating, fraud and forgery.

topics.title: Cyber crime
topics.detail: Online financial fraud, hacking, data theft, cyber defamation and trolling; online financial fraud can be reported on the 1930 helpline, and cybercrime complaints can be filed at cybercrime.gov.in.

topics.title: Women & children
topics.detail: Domestic violence, dowry harassment, sexual offences and cases under the POCSO Act, 2012.

topics.title: Special laws
topics.detail: Matters under the NDPS Act, the Prevention of Corruption Act and the Prevention of Money Laundering Act.

topics.title: Preventive & other proceedings
topics.detail: Security proceedings for keeping the peace, externment orders, quashing of FIRs by the High Court, and compounding or settlement of compoundable offences.

topics.title: Property & ownership
topics.detail: Declaration of title, partition, possession and eviction, easement and boundary disputes, adverse possession, encroachment and trespass.

topics.title: Succession & inheritance
topics.detail: Wills, intestate succession, succession certificates and family settlements.

topics.title: Contracts & business
topics.detail: Breach of contract, specific performance of agreements to sell, partnership and business disputes, arbitration and mediation.

topics.title: Recovery of money
topics.detail: Loans, advances and unpaid bills; mortgage, pledge and hypothecation disputes.

topics.title: Rent & tenancy
topics.detail: Eviction for non-payment or misuse, fixation of fair rent, landlord–tenant disputes, lease and licence agreements.

topics.title: Compensation claims
topics.detail: Motor accident claims before the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT), medical negligence, defamation, nuisance and trespass.

topics.title: Service & employment
topics.detail: Wrongful termination and recovery of salary and service benefits.

topics.title: Trusts, societies & companies
topics.detail: Management disputes in trusts, NGOs and societies, shareholder disputes, and dissolution of partnerships or trusts.

topics.title: Intellectual property
topics.detail: Trademark, copyright and patent infringement, passing off, and licensing and royalty disputes.

topics.title: Civil miscellaneous
topics.detail: Temporary and permanent injunctions, declaratory suits, execution of decrees (attachment, auction, recovery) and writ petitions.

topics.title: Deficiency in service
topics.detail: Banking, insurance, telecom, medical, education, travel and transport services.

topics.title: Defective goods
topics.detail: Electronics, vehicles, food, medicines and household products; warranty disputes.

topics.title: Unfair trade practices
topics.detail: Misleading advertisements, false promises, overcharging and hidden charges.

topics.title: Online shopping
topics.detail: Non-delivery, defective products and refusal of refund or return.

topics.title: Real estate
topics.detail: Delay in possession, poor construction quality and false promises by builders.

topics.title: Banking & insurance
topics.detail: Wrong deductions, ATM and card frauds, loan mis-selling, and delay or refusal of insurance claims.

topics.title: Education
topics.detail: Excessive fees, false placement guarantees and deficient services.

topics.title: Consumer Commission proceedings
topics.detail: Complaints before the District, State and National Consumer Commissions under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (including online filing through e-Jagriti), appeals, revisions and execution of orders for refund or compensation.

topics.title: Consumer mediation
topics.detail: Mediation under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and drafting enforceable settlement agreements.

topics.title: Consumer awareness
topics.detail: Awareness programmes on consumer rights and how to complain.

topics.title: Constitutional & writ matters
topics.detail: Enforcement of fundamental rights (Article 226 before the High Court and Article 32 before the Supreme Court), writs of habeas corpus, mandamus, certiorari, prohibition and quo warranto, and public interest litigation.

topics.title: Service law
topics.detail: Transfer, promotion, suspension, dismissal, seniority and reservation disputes of government employees; departmental inquiries.

topics.title: Labour & industrial disputes
topics.detail: Retrenchment, reinstatement, wages, gratuity, provident fund, bonus and overtime; cases before Labour Courts and Industrial Tribunals.

topics.title: Land & revenue
topics.detail: Mutation, correction of revenue records, partition before revenue courts, tenancy matters, land acquisition compensation, and proceedings before the Tehsildar, SDM and Collector.

topics.title: Tax
topics.detail: Income tax, GST, and property and municipal tax disputes.

topics.title: Banking & finance
topics.detail: Loan recovery before the Debts Recovery Tribunal, SARFAESI proceedings, NPA auctions, and guarantee and surety disputes.

topics.title: Company & insolvency
topics.detail: Oppression and mismanagement, shareholder disputes, and Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code proceedings before the NCLT and NCLAT.

topics.title: Election law
topics.detail: Election petitions for Parliament, Assembly, Panchayat and Municipal elections, disqualification and corrupt practices.

topics.title: Environment
topics.detail: Air, water and noise pollution, forest and wildlife matters, and cases before the National Green Tribunal.

topics.title: Cyber & IT law
topics.detail: IT contracts, data protection, and domain name and cybersquatting disputes.

topics.title: NRI & cross-border matters
topics.detail: NRI matrimonial and child custody disputes, cross-border commercial disputes and international arbitration.

topics.title: Arbitration, mediation & Lok Adalat
topics.detail: Arbitration and conciliation under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, mediation under the Mediation Act, 2023, and settlement before Lok Adalats.

topics.title: Right to Information
topics.detail: RTI applications, first appeals, and second appeals before the State or Central Information Commission.

topics.title: Senior citizens
topics.detail: Maintenance and protection of property under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007.

topics.title: Government schemes & welfare
topics.detail: Pensions, certificates, scholarships and grievances before government departments.

topics.title: Other disputes
topics.detail: Cooperative society disputes; trust, wakf and religious endowment disputes; civil and criminal defamation; and complaints of professional misconduct.

topics.title: Legal awareness programmes
topics.detail: For schools, colleges, panchayats, self-help groups and NGOs.

topics.title: Agreements & deeds
topics.detail: Agreements to sell, rent and lease agreements, gift deeds, wills, relinquishment deeds, partnership deeds and powers of attorney.

topics.title: Notices & affidavits
topics.detail: Legal notices and replies, affidavits and declarations.

topics.title: Court documents
topics.detail: Plaints, written statements, petitions and applications.

topics.title: Applications to authorities
topics.detail: Representations, complaints and applications to government departments.
